title: RawOsintEventMessage
description: Base schema for all unprocessed OSINT events published to the raw_events RabbitMQ exchange by ingestion scrapers.

app_ev_id.description: UUID generated at the scraper level to uniquely identify this event.

raw_message.description: The full raw message text from the source, unmodified.

timestamp.description: Event datetime produced by Python str(datetime). Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+HH:MM' (space separator, not ISO 8601 T).

source.description: Identifies the ingestion source (e.g. telegram, rss, twitter).

data.description: Source-specific payload. Shape depends on the value of source.
